scenes.title: Told a house in Jamaica will rent for good money? Check what tenants actually pay.
scenes.vo: Told a house in Jamaica will rent for good money? Check what tenants there actually pay, before you buy.
A hopeful rent can make any deal look good on paper.
Pick the parish. In this St James search, the median rent is seven hundred and fifty-six pounds a month, across two hundred and twenty-three listings.
If the deal only works well above what's typical, it's tighter than it looks. Follow for more ways to check a Jamaica deal.
Run your own numbers free with the APG Deal Analyser, in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. Link in my bio.
